description: Run a saved content automation rule by id on demand. Starts content generation with the rule's configuration, and the results can be scheduled or published according to its approval settings. Returns the trigger result. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_trigger_content_automation
title: Trigger Content Automation
